# MG996R 180 degree positional gripper servo — sourcing record

## Exact selected variant

TowerPro / TorqPro **MG996R Robot servo 180° Rotation**:
https://torqpro.com/product/mg996r-robot-servo-180x-rotation/

Use this named positional 180 degree variant. The manufacturer sells a separate continuous 360 degree variant. The ordinary MG996R page also has a manufacturer reply saying that ordinary version operates 0–159 degrees; the model name alone does not establish 180 degree travel.

## Manufacturer-confirmed specifications

- Mass: **55 g** (servo specification; website shipping weight is different).
- Published size: **40.7 × 19.7 × 42.9 mm**.
- Supply: **4.8–6.6 V**.
- Stall torque: **9.4 kgf cm at 4.8 V**, **11 kgf cm at 6 V**. These are stall values, not continuous gripper force ratings.
- No-load speed: **0.19 s/60° at4.8V**, **0.15 s/60° at6V**.
- Official manufacturer dimensional table: A42.7, B40.9, C37, D20, E54, F26.8 mm. The nominal size text and table differ slightly; preserve adjustable mounting clearances.

Original manufacturer page with the same table:
https://towerpro.com.tw/product/mg996r/

## Dimensional drawing sources and uncertainty

A distributor's dimensional drawing reproduces the manufacturer's A–F table and 3 views, on PDF page3:
https://agelectronica.lat/pdfs/textos/M/MG996R.PDF

Another direct supplier publishes its own MG996R drawing on PDF page2:
https://www.handsontec.com/dataspecs/motor_fan/MG996R.pdf

That drawing gives body length40.3, width20, casing height36.6, lower mounting plane26.6, overall with horn47.6, ear span53.6 mm. These differ from manufacturer42.7/40.9/54 table; do not combine them as if they establish one exact part revision.

**Mount hole pattern and shaft offset are not verified against the exact180 variant.** Community references often report49.5×10 mm, some report48×10 mm; do not freeze a printed mounting hole pattern from these conflicting sources. Body/recess can be drawing-based with adjustable slots; source exact purchased part dimensions before printrelease. The shaft lies off-centre along the body length; ~10mm from the short end is an unverified planning assumption, not manufacturer-certified dimension.

## CAD status

No unrestricted official MG996R STEP was found in this sourcing pass. GrabCAD requires a signed-in account. Publicly downloaded ST3215, SG90 and Futaba3003 assets from the preceding revision do **not** match MG996R and were not copied or relabeled. Browser tool use is now approval-blocked and shell network resolution is restricted; no access bypass attempted.

Any CAD generated from these sources must be labeled **drawing-based reconstruction / fit pending**, not manufacturerCAD. Geometry from a nominal servo model cannot prove180degree positional travel.
